dispatcher_prerequisites: publish feature/automation-adoption and develop to the owner-controlled fork
register the project-local queue on the automation host
materialize a clean managed checkout from origin/develop
verify Java 21 launcher, Java 11 toolchain and Android SDK
run queue, packet, freshness and agent-state guards before every claim

tasks.title: Remote managed checkout and Android toolchain
acceptance_criteria: Remote registry points at an isolated managed checkout of origin/develop.
Java 21 launches Gradle while modules compile with the Java 11 toolchain.
Android SDK is explicit and verifyProject plus assembleDebug pass remotely.

tasks.title: Characterize current gameplay behavior
acceptance_criteria: Tests lock validation feedback, latest-attempt scrolling and the 0000/4060 deduction scenario.
Hints, boosts, reset, win/loss and manual marks are characterized without testing private functions.

tasks.title: Typed guess validation contract
acceptance_criteria: Validation returns typed reasons and never depends on English message comparison.
Length, digit, duplicate, all-same, adjacency and triple rules have unit tests.
A temporary compatible bridge preserves callers until route integration.

tasks.title: Pure evidence and deduction engine
acceptance_criteria: Manual hypotheses, accepted-attempt evidence and proven facts are separate types.
Inference reaches a deterministic fixpoint and reports typed contradictions.
The 0000 plus known 4 plus 4060 scenario proves 6 in position three.

tasks.title: Typed match feedback and validated checkpoint
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot feedback is typed and corrupted boost text is repaired.
A validated checkpoint restores secret, phase, attempts and extra moves without regeneration.
Invalid checkpoints fail closed and secrets never enter logs.

tasks.title: GameField state holder and SavedState restoration
acceptance_criteria: Typed state and events own match parameters, input, evidence, manual marks, timers, tools and counters.
SavedStateHandle restores the checkpoint without replaying one-shot rewards or callbacks.
State code contains no localized strings or Compose types.

tasks.title: Stateless GameScreen presentation components
acceptance_criteria: GameScreen is the stateless renderer of GameFieldUiState and callbacks.
Top, attempts, analysis, helpers, tools and input are separate presentation components.
Debug secret remains an optional debug slot for current owner testing.

tasks.title: Thin GameField route and active UI switch
acceptance_criteria: GameFieldScreen becomes a route adapter targeting about 250 lines and binds the ViewModel to GameScreen.
Duplicate engine, inference, timer and mutable-board ownership is removed.
Current debug testing contour and all characterized behavior remain available.

tasks.title: Typed localization catalogs and parity tests
acceptance_criteria: RU and EN are decomposed into feature catalogs aggregated by StaticLocalizationProvider.
Tests fail on duplicate keys or unequal locale key sets.
Unknown-key fallback is explicit and current visible strings do not change.

tasks.title: Home and shell localization
acceptance_criteria: Home, dialogs, setup and navigation have complete RU/EN keys.
No mixed English remains under RU and typed placeholders replace concatenation.

tasks.title: Secondary and developer screen localization
acceptance_criteria: User and developer labels have RU/EN coverage without hiding technical identifiers.
Current developer controls remain available and behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: Game localization convergence
acceptance_criteria: Game text and content descriptions have complete RU/EN keys.
Validation/status mapping uses typed reasons, not translated-string comparison.
Mojibake is absent and match behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: SQLite schema and safe test seam
acceptance_criteria: Schema/create/migrate are separated from repository CRUD without changing production defaults.
Tests use unique database names and injected time, never the user database.
No destructive migration is introduced.

tasks.title: SQLite migrations and repository tests
acceptance_criteria: Fresh v6 and every v1-v5 to v6 migration preserve sentinel data.
Progress, entitlement, inventory, energy, identity, room, turn and sync queue round trips are covered.
Tests create and remove only their own unique databases.

tasks.title: CI foundation and artifact identity
acceptance_criteria: CI uses Java 21 launcher and Java 11 toolchain and runs unit verification plus debug assemble.
Artifacts include version, commit and SHA-256 identity.
Instrumentation and release checks are visible but non-blocking until their dedicated tasks pass.

tasks.title: Recreation contradiction and regression suite
acceptance_criteria: Activity recreation and SavedState restoration preserve secret, attempts, input and analysis.
Manual contradictions never become facts and confirmed hints cannot create impossible boards.
All three owner-reported defects remain closed.

tasks.title: Lint cleanup and blocking quality gate
acceptance_criteria: Current lint errors are fixed without blanket suppression.
Unit, lint, UI smoke and release assemble become blocking CI checks.
Artifact version and signing status are explicitly reported.

tasks.title: Debug and release source-set isolation
acceptance_criteria: Owner debug tools remain available in debug builds.
Release cannot render secret/debug controls or include debug fixtures.
Release behavior is verified by variant-aware tests.

tasks.title: Release provider fail-closed policy
acceptance_criteria: Fake sign-in, mock purchases and test ads remain debug-only.
Release fails closed when a production provider is absent or misconfigured.
No credential or personal endpoint enters source, logs or artifacts.

tasks.title: Versioned online REST WebSocket and security contracts
acceptance_criteria: Versioned guest auth, cloud save, matchmaking, duel commands, snapshots and WS events are specified.
Idempotency, optimistic concurrency, reconnect, redaction and secret ownership are explicit.
Contracts are transport-neutral and testable.

tasks.title: Modular Ktor backend and health contract
acceptance_criteria: Backend starts as modular Ktor with tested health and readiness endpoints.
Configuration is environment-driven and sanitized logging is used.
No production secret is required by tests.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL persistence and migrations
acceptance_criteria: Versioned migrations create player, save, ticket, session, command and event storage.
Repository tests cover rollback, constraints and concurrent revisions.
Migration and application credentials stay external.

tasks.title: Guest identity profile and versioned cloud save
acceptance_criteria: Guest bootstrap creates stable player identity and bounded renewable credentials.
Profile and cloud save use optimistic revisions with explicit conflict responses.
Tests cover replay, expiry, retry and redacted logs.

tasks.title: Authoritative duel aggregate
acceptance_criteria: Pure aggregate owns setup, turn order, scoring, win state and public snapshot.
Opponent secret never enters public state.
Commands and invariant failures have deterministic unit tests.

tasks.title: Idempotent session persistence and reconnect
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate command ids are safe and version conflicts are explicit.
Committed state and ordered events survive process restart.
Reconnect returns a bounded authoritative snapshot without secret leakage.

tasks.title: Matchmaking and server bot fallback
acceptance_criteria: Ticket lifecycle and cancellation are explicit and idempotent.
Bot fallback orchestrates the shared bot core rather than creating a second engine.
Pending bot turns recover safely after restart.

tasks.title: Backend REST and WebSocket routes
acceptance_criteria: REST bootstrap/save/matchmaking and authenticated WS session routes implement the versioned contract.
Heartbeat, backpressure, reconnect and protocol errors have integration tests.
Tokens, secrets and personal data are sanitized in logs.

tasks.title: Android online transport foundation
acceptance_criteria: REST and WebSocket clients sit behind existing app boundaries.
Timeout, retry, connectivity and token refresh are deterministic and tested.
Offline local play stays available.

tasks.title: Android guest auth and cloud-save adapter
acceptance_criteria: Guest identity is persisted securely and cloud save uses explicit revision conflicts.
Offline changes queue and reconcile without silent loss.
Tests cover retry, conflict and token expiry.

tasks.title: Android duel WebSocket and reconnect flow
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative turn, timeout, reconnect and result states render from server snapshots.
Duplicate events and reconnect do not duplicate turns or rewards.
Opponent secret never appears in the normal UI or logs.

tasks.title: Local containers migrations and operations runbook
acceptance_criteria: Backend and PostgreSQL start locally with persistent data and health checks.
Migration, backup, restore and rollback commands are documented and tested.
Only placeholders are stored in repository configuration.

tasks.title: Owner-gated staging VPS activation
acceptance_criteria: Exact VPS target, ports, domain, artifact and rollback path are recorded before mutation.
Staging is deployed from an identified artifact with persistent PostgreSQL.
Deployment remains reversible and does not change unrelated services.

tasks.title: TLS firewall backup and rollback verification
acceptance_criteria: TLS, least-open firewall, health checks and log redaction are verified.
Backup restore and application rollback are exercised with evidence.
Secrets remain only in the target secret store.

tasks.title: Two-client online E2E and failure recovery
acceptance_criteria: Two clients complete an authoritative duel against staging.
Reconnect, duplicate command, timeout, restart and bot fallback pass.
Logs contain no secret, token or direct personal data.

tasks.title: Post-core UX contract and screen inventory
acceptance_criteria: Race, Duel, Company and secondary-screen journeys have explicit state contracts.
Compact/tall phone, accessibility and localization constraints are defined.
No design task changes gameplay rules.

tasks.title: Race vertical UX UI slice
acceptance_criteria: Race field follows the approved contract without losing attempts, analysis, hints, tools or timer.
State is not conveyed by color alone and compact/tall phones pass visual acceptance.

tasks.title: Duel and Company vertical UX UI slice
acceptance_criteria: Setup, waiting, turn, timeout, reconnect and result states are explicit.
Remote opponent and server bot share presentation states.
Opponent secret never appears in normal UI.

tasks.title: Secondary screens UX UI slice
acceptance_criteria: Secondary screens share semantic tokens and preserve all current actions.
RU/EN, accessibility, compact and tall layouts have acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: Real Google auth provider
acceptance_criteria: Production Google auth is real, server-verified and replaceable behind the provider contract.
Debug fake sign-in remains available only in debug.
Credentials remain outside Git.

tasks.title: Real billing receipt verification and ads provider
acceptance_criteria: Release billing uses server receipt verification and idempotent entitlement grants.
Release ads use the production provider with consent and failure fallback.
Mock purchase and test ads remain debug-only.

tasks.title: Canonical architecture testing and operations documentation
acceptance_criteria: Docs describe actual route to ViewModel to GameScreen boundaries and evidence semantics.
Testing, migrations, online operations and rollback commands match the implemented system.
Technical debt and changelog reflect verified reality.

tasks.title: Final integration release artifact and acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Offline, bot, campaign and online flows pass complete acceptance.
Signed APK/AAB identity, version, commit and SHA-256 are recorded without exposing signing material.
A physical-phone acceptance run passes and rollback is documented.
tasks.notes: Integrator-only container. Dispatcher must split implementation fixes before any Worker claim.
